summary.text: Lino Avellani is a Republican state representative from Carroll 4 who has served in the House since 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Avellani is a restaurant owner and chef who has served on the House Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lino Avellani's career experience includes owning and working as a chef at Lino's Restaurant.
Avellani was assigned to the House Labor, Industrial and Rehabilitative Services Committee in each session Ballotpedia lists from 2015 through 2024.
